improvements: Refreshed the full mapped grandstand ring and all ten lower-deck parts with their individual tagged 20 m tops and skillion roof directions.
Rebuilt the complete tapered parked roof as a curved 46–66 m source contour on mapped 46 m runways.
Retained source roof/deck identities explicitly; neighbouring warehouses remain outside replacement scope.
remainingGaps: The three retractable panels and small cone/overlap part w1451834521 share a simplified continuous parked roof surface rather than individually moving mechanical assemblies.
Runway trusses, seating rows, roof-lettering artwork and exact steel connection details remain simplified.
Pitch and dirt infield retain the prior measured outline rather than a fresh baseball-field survey.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The shared explicit-ID source-replacement implementation is integrated in production (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13). These studies retain their actual capture-era source and do not establish current district placement, road/body clearance, traffic/mirror budgets or seasonal parity. Registry entries outside a district list and context-only models with no replacement IDs do not replace neighbouring buildings.
